ops.body:
Amended reposync migration VERIFIED (replaces the original wrap): the failing tombstoned+local_only entry stays in `repos` with `local_only` forced false — behaviorally inert for absent entries (AllRepos/PropagatingRepos read Value only for Present()), and KEEPING the tombstone is load-bearing: EncodeRepoRegistry marshals the propagating map with no local_only filter, so peers may hold the id; dropping the tombstone would let cregistry.Merge re-admit it (Compact doc names this exact failure). Artifacts on the lead machine: /tmp/reposync-repair.sh (idempotent, temp-file writes, preserves stamps, refuses-with-exit-5 on a PRESENT local_only entry in repos rather than guessing) + /tmp/reposync-audit.jq (read-only classifier, run first). Verified end-to-end in sandbox incl. the exact failing entry, write round-trip, idempotence, and the refuse case. Residual risk bounded: a ≤0.19 peer with the same add-stamp could reintroduce local_only:true via the lexicographic tie-break — entry stays absent either way; re-run the audit if the error recurs; 0.27.4 peers self-heal.

NEW LIVE BUG (being filed in reposync backlog): `repo add --local-only` on a repo WITH an origin remote writes exactly this rejected shape TODAY on 0.27.4 (repo.go only clears origin in the ErrNoOrigin branch; AddRepo routes on Origin=="") — the next command load then wedges the entire CLI. Likely origin of the yasyf-home anomaly.

Both machine lanes carry the amended protocol (audit → migrate → repo-ls gate → install). Box is BACK online; its lane resumed with re-caffeinate + reboot-check + cc-pool verify-first ordering.
